title: Coordinated plan selection

scenario_notes.shift: Synthetic demand shifts toward cross streets at 6:20, then toward avenues at 9:40.

plan_library.objective: Mean requested-cohort delay; best static minimizes equal-weight mean across AM, surge and shifting demand.

cross_flow.label: Local volume-weighted splits with cross-street emphasis

methods.clock: Actual preparation and inference time included in 1x real-time Jev runs; numerical computation is measured. Plan installation waits for eligible local cycle starts.

limitations: NYC-informed, schematic and vehicle-only; not field validated.
Five fresh paired seeds per scenario; exploratory pilot without multiple-comparison adjustment.
Synthetic surge and directional changes, not observed NYC events.
Forecasts use assumed discharge rates and recent detected arrivals; no incident semantics, sensing delays or learned forecasting.
All candidate plans retain a 90 s cycle and the original offsets. This version selects green-split profiles only.

execution_retry.reason: All 15 live attempts violated the pre-existing maximum wall-clock lag criterion (<0.2 s). macOS power log records clamshell sleep and maintenance sleep during the batch. These attempts are excluded on timing validity, not traffic performance.
